task: Broad historical evidence search and replay source resilience
purpose: Determine whether a wider authentic DreamDEX historical window could safely replace the current one-market Proven Experiment without fabrication, cherry-picking, or threshold changes.

observedReplayAttempts.finding: Orders/fills/candles and cutoff source errors were being excluded, but an unbounded outcome read could stall the broad replay.
Outcome source reads were timeout-bounded, but the broad replay still stalled before producing a completed auditable artifact.

implementedCorrection.runtime: Historical replay now converts rejected source reads into DREAMDEX_HISTORICAL_READ_FAILED results, timeout-wraps cutoff and outcome source reads, and classifies HTTP/deadline/outcome source failures as per-market excluded evidence.
implementedCorrection.regressionTest: tests/integration/api.test.ts: completes replay with excluded evidence when a market source read fails

integrityDecision.reason: The wider evidence candidate did not reach COMPLETED replay state, so it cannot replace the current public Proven Experiment.

nextTechnicalNeed.summary: Broad replay needs throughput/state hardening before a wider completed artifact can become public proof.
likelyWork: cache or batch historical cutoff block resolution
add a replay job watchdog for stalled RUNNING jobs
capture per-market source stage in checkpoints before every external read
